summary: OSpec 1.9.3 fixes two field-discovered planning-gate dead ends so an approved Goal can no longer be re-blocked by derived execution state or by a repair whose completion evidence never settled.
fixed: tasks.md now contributes a constant to the planning semantic snapshot: repair-wave checklist lines, closeout checklists, and other derived churn can no longer invalidate an approved combined planning review mid-goal.

A dispatched grouped planning repair whose completion evidence never settled is closed out automatically when a later combined planning review approves the planning content, instead of being misread later as a partial edit that permanently blocks the Goal after its work was approved.
Post-repair review context sections now also cover dispatched-but-unsettled repairs, so a fresh planning reviewer always sees which findings the repair was resolving.
